name: Trump International Hotel & Tower, New York
positioning: Hotel in a 52-story building at 1 Central Park West, across from Central Park on Columbus Circle
best_for: Travelers who want a base across from Central Park, steps from Lincoln Center and Fifth Avenue
Groups or longer stays that need suites with up to four bedrooms and a kitchen

facts.text: The hotel's address is 1 Central Park West, New York.
The hotel sits across from Central Park on Columbus Circle, in a 52-story building.
The hotel is steps from Columbus Circle, Lincoln Center and Fifth Avenue.
Suites come with one, two, three or four bedrooms.
The hotel has suites with kitchens.
Rooms are apartment-style, with a color palette of gray, aubergine, ivory and caramel.
Rooms have Schonbek crystal chandeliers over the dining table and rosewood, mahogany, maple and walnut finishes.
Both Jean Georges and Nougatine are run by Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
Nougatine is a more casual expression of Jean-Georges, set between Central Park views and an exhibition kitchen.
Nougatine's menu features signature Jean-Georges dishes alongside seasonal daily specials.
The hotel offers the personalized Trump Attache service.
The hotel's Concierge team personally recommends curated New York City experiences.

highlights.text: In the warmer months, the park-facing Mistral Terrace has Dedon furniture designed by Philippe Starck and serves the full Nougatine menu with signature cocktails.
Every room and suite has floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Central Park and the Manhattan skyline.
At evening turndown, water is served in Rogaska glasses.
Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2017, 2018, 2019, 2024 and 2025.

considerations.text: Travelers of all ages are welcome, but guests must be 21 or older to check into their own room.
The hotel is 100% smoke free, and a $1,000 cleaning fee applies to any room where smoking is apparent.
Business casual attire is required at Nougatine, and its outdoor seating is weather dependent.
